about_the_game:
A puzzle game about connecting planets, making deliveries, and dealing with the weirdest customers in the galaxy.

📦 Deliveries in Space? Easier Said Than Done.

Minuto is just a rabbit trying to do his job—flying across the galaxy, delivering packages, and making sure everything arrives on time and in one piece. But space is tricky. Planets move, gravity pulls, and sometimes your customers are way too picky.

🌀 Figure out the best routes to link up planets and sync deliveries.
🪐 Watch out for cosmic chaos—asteroids, wormholes, and time loops can mess up even the best-laid plans.
🎭 Meet strange (and demanding) customers who always have something interesting to say.
📖 Uncover the hidden history of the galaxy, one delivery at a time.

🚀 WHAT TO EXPECT:

✅ A Puzzle About Connections – Every level is a new challenge in timing and precision.
✅ Space Is a Mess – Expect surprises, from unexpected obstacles to completely ridiculous delivery requests.
✅ Relaxing but Tricky – A chill, atmospheric vibe with puzzles that will definitely make you think.
✅ There’s More Than Meets the Eye – Strange things are happening in this galaxy… if you pay attention.

💡 Simple Idea, Endless Possibilities.

If you like clever puzzles with a bit of humor, Minuto - Galactic Delivery is for you.

🚀 Wishlist now and get ready to deliver!
